title: How long-distance relationships work
titleChinese: 异地恋该如何维护感情
paragraphs: Most of us dream of meeting that special someone. For lack of a better phrase, that Prince or Princess charming who will sweep us off our feet. But to quote the old adage from Shakespeare, “The course of true love never did run smooth.” Sometimes our dream partner may have an unfortunate surprise to share with us – they may not live in the same town, city, country, or even on the same continent as you.

And so some crazy lovebirds decide to enter into a long-distance relationship. We live in a time when the internet facilitates easier interaction with your cherished and treasured potential life partner. However, according to the many people who have been in long-distance relationships, there are certain pitfalls that you need to be aware of to enjoy a committed and monogamous relationship over the wires of the net.

Many people are put off by the very idea of it. A lack of intimacy and companionship can act as a deterrent for some, but for those who embrace a digital distance relationship, they must accept that at times they may feel lonely. Many of us dream of that inseparable bond, often named as ‘soulmates’, and here are three tips to help you navigate this potentially tricky form of dating.

Firstly, there needs to be trust. Being faithful is a prerequisite in most relationships, but you also need to be able to trust yourself not to stray. Part of the challenge is dealing with loneliness. Also, maintaining a level of self-sufficiency and setting goals is another way to help you cope. Not only does it mean you keep your independence, but also gives you more to talk about with your partner. Lastly, you need a plan – dates when you will see each other again, or where the relationship will lead to: perhaps even marriage.
So, long-distance relationships are potentially a difficult situation, but if you do meet Mr or Mrs Right, and they live far away, there are some steps you can take to make life a little easier.

vocabulary.entry: special someone /ˈspeʃl ˈsʌmwʌn/ 心仪之人；那个特别的人
vocabulary.example: She’s still waiting to meet her special someone.
vocabulary.translation: 她还在等着遇见自己的心仪之人。

vocabulary.entry: sweep sb off one's feet /swiːp ˈsʌmbədi ɒf wʌnz fiːt/ 使某人神魂颠倒；令某人倾心（俗语）
vocabulary.example: He was swept off his feet by her charm and beauty.
vocabulary.translation: 他被她的魅力和美貌迷得神魂颠倒。

vocabulary.entry: old adage /əʊld ˈædɪdʒ/ 古老的格言；老话
vocabulary.example: Remember the old adage: honesty is the best policy.
vocabulary.translation: 记住那句老话：诚实是上策。

vocabulary.entry: course of true love /kɔːs ɒv truː lʌv/ 真爱之路
vocabulary.example: They soon discovered that the course of true love is never smooth.
vocabulary.translation: 他们很快就发现，真爱之路从来都不会一帆风顺。

vocabulary.entry: run smooth /rʌn smuːð/ 进展顺利；一帆风顺
vocabulary.example: We hope that everything will run smooth on the wedding day.
vocabulary.translation: 我们希望婚礼当天一切都能进展顺利。

vocabulary.entry: dream partner /driːm ˈpɑːtnə(r)/ 理想伴侣；梦中情人
vocabulary.example: She finally found her dream partner after years of waiting.
vocabulary.translation: 经过多年等待，她终于找到了自己的理想伴侣。

vocabulary.entry: lovebird /ˈlʌvbɜːd/ n. 情侣（俚语）
vocabulary.example: The two lovebirds were sitting on the bench, talking and laughing.
vocabulary.translation: 那对情侣坐在长椅上，有说有笑。

vocabulary.entry: long-distance relationship /ˌlɒŋ ˈdɪstəns rɪˈleɪʃnʃɪp/ 异地恋
vocabulary.example: Keeping a long-distance relationship requires a lot of trust and patience.
vocabulary.translation: 维系一段异地恋需要很多信任和耐心。

vocabulary.entry: facilitate /fəˈsɪlɪteɪt/ v. 促进；使便利
vocabulary.example: Online platforms facilitate communication between people from different countries.
vocabulary.translation: 线上平台促进了不同国家人们之间的交流。

vocabulary.entry: interaction /ˌɪntərˈækʃn/ n. 互动；交流
vocabulary.example: Regular interaction is essential for a healthy relationship.
vocabulary.translation: 定期互动对于一段健康的感情至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: cherished /ˈtʃerɪʃt/ adj. 珍爱的；珍视的
vocabulary.example: The locket is one of her most cherished possessions.
vocabulary.translation: 这枚小挂坠是她最珍爱的物品之一。

vocabulary.entry: potential /pəˈtenʃl/ adj. 潜在的；可能的
vocabulary.example: The course helps you develop your potential as a writer.
vocabulary.translation: 这门课程有助于你发掘自己作为作家的潜力。

vocabulary.entry: pitfall /ˈpɪtfɔːl/ n. 潜在的隐患；陷阱
vocabulary.example: One of the pitfalls of online shopping is buying items of poor quality.
vocabulary.translation: 网购的潜在隐患之一就是买到劣质商品。

vocabulary.entry: committed /kəˈmɪtɪd/ adj. 忠诚的；坚定的
vocabulary.example: They are in a committed relationship and plan to get married next year.
vocabulary.translation: 他们处于一段忠诚的感情中，计划明年结婚。

vocabulary.entry: monogamous /məˈnɒɡəməs/ adj. 一夫一妻的；专一的
vocabulary.example: Most people in this country prefer a monogamous marriage.
vocabulary.translation: 这个国家的大多数人都倾向于一夫一妻制的婚姻。

vocabulary.entry: put off /pʊt ɒf/ 使反感；使望而却步
vocabulary.example: The high cost of the course put many students off.
vocabulary.translation: 这门课程的高昂费用让很多学生望而却步。

vocabulary.entry: intimacy /ˈɪntɪməsi/ n. 亲密感；亲昵
vocabulary.example: Sharing secrets can help build intimacy between friends.
vocabulary.translation: 分享秘密有助于增进朋友之间的亲密感。

vocabulary.entry: companionship /kəmˈpænjənʃɪp/ n. 陪伴；情谊
vocabulary.example: She enjoyed the companionship of her pet dog during her illness.
vocabulary.translation: 生病期间，她很享受宠物狗的陪伴。

vocabulary.entry: deterrent /dɪˈterənt/ n. 阻碍因素；威慑物
vocabulary.example: The fear of failure is a major deterrent to many people.
vocabulary.translation: 对失败的恐惧是很多人的主要阻碍因素。

vocabulary.entry: soulmate /ˈsəʊlmeɪt/ n. 灵魂伴侣
vocabulary.example: He believes that his wife is his soulmate and they understand each other perfectly.
vocabulary.translation: 他认为妻子就是自己的灵魂伴侣，两人彼此非常理解。

vocabulary.entry: prerequisite /ˌpriːˈrekwəzɪt/ n. 前提；先决条件
vocabulary.example: Good communication is a prerequisite for a successful team.
vocabulary.translation: 良好的沟通是一个成功团队的先决条件。

vocabulary.entry: self-sufficiency /ˌself səˈfɪʃnsi/ n. 自给自足；自立
vocabulary.example: The country aims to achieve self-sufficiency in food production.
vocabulary.translation: 这个国家致力于实现粮食生产的自给自足。
